messages.author: 6fb14495402860ef
messages.subject: Combining Home Range faster
parts:
Hello, I want to estimate Home Range of seagulls using ctmm package. When I tried to combine Home Ranges obtained from multiple individuals, I got to know that mean() function could combine 'UD' objects and that objects should be in same grid.

In order to make 'UD' objects in same grid, I input data from multiple individuals at once when I use as.telemetry function and akde function. However I got a huge problem that it takes so long than input data independently.

I infered that the variability among individuals(wide movement range and narrow movement range) causes that time problems and if there was a way to convert ready-made'UD' object convert in other grid, it should solve the problem.

Is there any other method to combine 'UD' objects faster or convert grid of UD obejct?

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Combining Home Range faster
parts: Hi, estimating everything on the same grid can be much slower if the individuals are spread out and yet sampled enough to be calculated at a high resolution. What you can do to speed things up is adjust the res or grid options to lower the resolution. I suggest maintaining res>=1.

messages.subject: Re: Combining Home Range faster
parts:
Thank you for your answer. 

Your suggestion about using 'res' or 'grid' parameter works well. I can calculate UD faster. When I calculate with  'weights = F' condition, I can get result sufficiently fast with 'res=1'condition (4~5 min) but I have to use 'weights = TRUE' condition due to my irregularly sampled data and with 'weights = TRUE' condition it takes so long even with 'res = 0.01' option.


When I convert my data to 'telemetry' objects, I received warning messages like 'Times might be out of order or duplicated in ke1511_winter. Make sure that timeformat and timezone are correctly specified.'.
But I'm sure that my data has not duplicated times and my date data follows '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' format. Because 'weights' option is related with time, I think that it can the reason.

In this situation, what can I do for make faster?

Thank you for your work

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Combining Home Range faster
parts:
There are a number of arguments that can greatly impact the speed of bandwidth optimization when using weights=TRUE, and there are a lot of details on this in the documentation: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/bandwidth.html#details Feel free to raise any further questions or issues not covered there.

That warning message should not be ignored if it doesn't ring true, because it could indicate that your timestamps are not being correctly imported. Other issues that could cause this are an incorrect time zone or the column names not following closely enough to Movebank conventions.

You're welcome,
Chris
